title: SectionViewStyle class-header insertion
summary: Generalized the typed-over-raw class-header insertion helper to SectionViewStyle and added generated ASCII/Binary insertion and fail-closed overflow controls.

behavior.headerOrder: Class version group 70 precedes flags group 90, and both precede the first group-71 style-group marker.
behavior.range: Class versions above INT16_MAX are refused; uint32 flags use signed DXF-long encoding and round-trip to the original value.
behavior.failClosed: Header insertion accepts only the known 70/90 header prefix and refuses unfamiliar prefix fields instead of guessing.
behavior.compatibility: The existing DetailViewStyle insertion path now uses the same subclass-bounded helper; no public callback surface changed.

coverage: Missing SectionViewStyle class-version and flags inserted in header order
High-bit flags re-import as the original uint32 value
Exact ordered SectionViewStyle raw carrier and unchanged DetailViewStyle carrier
Closed resource references and following POINT continuity
Out-of-range class version refused without replacing the destination sentinel
Unfamiliar class-header prefix refused without replacing the destination sentinel

validation.scopedDiffCheck: git diff --check passed for changed production, test, and plan paths; added receipts checked separately

scope.commitBlocker: Workspace Git metadata is read-only; changes remain unstaged and uncommitted.
